name: pi
description: AI agent toolkit: unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI, coding agent CLI
one_liner: A toolkit for building your own AI coding assistant or AI agent app: one unified way to talk to any AI model (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google), plus the plumbing (agent loop, terminal UI) to build agents on top.
buyer: A developer or small startup building their own AI-agent product who doesn't want to build the LLM-switching and agent-loop plumbing from scratch.
business_use_cases: An aspiring AI founder uses it as the backend for a niche vertical AI agent, such as a legal-research assistant, instead of building the agent runtime themselves — directly addressing 'want to build an AI product but don't know where to start.'
A dev-tools startup builds a custom coding-agent CLI for a specific language or framework on top of pi's agent core rather than starting from zero.
An internal platform team standardizes on pi's unified LLM API so switching AI providers doesn't require rewriting application code.

money_ideas.idea: Build and sell a vertical AI agent product, such as customer support or legal research, using pi as the underlying engine
Offer paid integration or consulting for companies wanting to add an AI agent to their product using pi's toolkit

steal_this: This weekend, build a narrow vertical agent (for example, one that only triages expense reports) on top of pi's agent core, and ship it as a small monthly micro-SaaS.
